Chapter 231: Chapter 20: Star Domain Rankings (Please Subscribe)

Chapter 231: Chapter 20: Star Domain Rankings (Please Subscribe)

“Martial Path Evolutionary Path…”

Lin Yuan’s thoughts diverged, his expression showing brief contemplation.

After its refinement, the Martial Path Evolutionary Path saw a significant enhancement in potential.

Apart from the Dao of Taiji formed by Taiyin and Taiyang, evolvers could choose their own preferred paths and then combine them with others to form many branches.

Furthermore, the lower limit of the Martial Path Evolutionary Path, or more accurately, the training threshold, had also been reduced significantly.

Simply put, it is more adaptable, and the evolvers practicing Martial Dao have greater hopes of advancing to the Third Rank, Fourth Rank, and Fifth Rank.

...

“Spreading the Evolutionary Path related to oneself, the more lives that practice it, the more it enhances certain foundations, aiding the ‘Ultimate Leap’ in the future…

Lin Yuan thought to himself.

The ‘related to oneself’ here could be like the Ancient Gods Evolutionary Path, imitating everything about the ‘Ancient Gods’.

It could also be like Lin Yuan, who established a certain Evolutionary Path and then spread it.

“Goddess of Wisdom.”

Lin Yuan actively connected to the Goddess of Wisdom.

“Respected Level-5 Citizen Lin Yuan, the Goddess of Wisdom is pleased to serve you.”

The solemn and chilly voice of the Goddess of Wisdom came through.

“I need to ‘update’ the Martial Path Evolutionary Path.”

Lin Yuan spoke.

Lin Yuan had not yet created the Sixth Rank Chapter of the Martial Path Evolutionary Path, so it was somewhat inaccurate to say he was uploading.

It was merely a refinement of the previously existing Second Layer Chapter, Third Rank Chapter, Fourth Rank Chapter, and Fifth Rank Section, so it was more appropriate to refer to it as an ‘update.’

Afterwards,

Lin Yuan then synchronized the refined Martial Path Evolutionary Path to the Goddess of Wisdom in its entirety.

Just after the Goddess of Wisdom received the Martial Path Evolutionary Path,

Hum.

In a Mysterious Space far away from the Chikun Main Star,

Massive screens flickered rapidly, crazily analyzing and deducing the latest Martial Path Evolutionary Path.

“This evolutionary path is likely to advance to the Eighth Layer; reevaluation beginning…”

“Preliminary evaluation: the latest Martial Path Evolutionary Path significantly reduces the training threshold and increases ultimate potential.”

“Beginning in-depth evaluation…”

“In-depth evaluation: starting from the Second Layer Chapter, the difficulty of training shows a significant downward trend; analyzing reasons… This evolutionary path incorporates various energies into the system…”

“In-depth evaluation… The fusion of different energies will produce unforeseen variables, which could be worse or better…”

“In-depth evaluation… Evaluation of Martial Path Evolutionary Path enhanced, overall potential increased….”

“In-depth evaluation… The creator of this evolutionary path, personal security level risen, reached nine-star level….”

“Contacting the Goddess of Freedom, Goddess of Justice, reevaluation starting….”

….

Chikun Main Star.

At the Central Plaza.

Heiyu Mo’s expression remained unchanged, but inside he was growing anxious.

“What does this Thirteen Peak Master mean?”

“I’ve mentioned offering treasures, yet he won’t even meet with me?”

Heiyu Mo’s eyebrows twitched.

He regarded his actions as flawless; coming here to apologize and seeking an audience with the Thirteen Peaks Master, everything was logical and legitimate.

He couldn’t find any fault.

Even if the Thirteen Peaks Master didn’t forgive him,

He ought to at least meet with him once to inquire what treasures were offered, right?

But now,

His self-abasing plea had not received any response at all.

“If I wait any longer, the Thirteen Peaks Master may complete the integration of the life brand…”

Heiyu Mo steadied his spirit and suppressed the restlessness in his heart.

If the Thirteen Peaks Master successfully integrates the life brand, even if Heiyu Mo successfully kills him, he would be smoothly ‘resurrected’ later on.

Indeed, that Evolver from the Insect Race had said, regardless of whether he could utterly destroy the Thirteen Peaks Master,

his clan and race would receive sufficient favor and corresponding resource allocation.

But utterly destroying the Thirteen Peaks Master versus not achieving an utter destruction or not killing at all, would definitely affect the final treatment of his race.

Since he would die in the aftermath no matter what, Heiyu Mo naturally hoped his death would be worthwhile.

“No rush.”

“Take your time.”

“I now must not reveal any abnormality.”

Heiyu Mo knew, being in the Red Kun Lineage, he was being watched by countless eyes.

He had to maintain a demeanor befitting his status.

“I don’t believe the Thirteen Peaks Master won’t come out.”

Heiyu Mo took a deep breath.

Estimating the time, the Thirteen Peaks Master must have completed the integration of the life brand by now.

Heiyu Mo knew, the chance to utterly destroy the Thirteen Peaks Master was no longer substantial.

Now he could only consider killing the Thirteen Peaks Master, and even if he was ‘resurrected’ by the Human Race’s Supreme Being later, it would be many years later.

And for the Human Race to resurrect the Thirteen Peaks Master, a huge price would need to be paid; the Evolver from the Insect Race had tasked Heiyu Mo with the assassination, risking his life.

And Heiyu Mo never considered making the Supreme Being of the Insect Race resurrect him.

Because the Insect Race would likely never agree.

Even if the Insect Race agreed, Heiyu Mo wouldn’t believe it.

…

At the palace atop the Thirteen Peaks.

Lin Yuan waited for a while and, finding that the Goddess of Wisdom was still evaluating the Martial Path Evolutionary Path, he connected his consciousness to the Virtual World and entered his personal space.

“Hmm?”

Lin Yuan glanced at the visitor request list.

The list was densely packed. At a rough count, there were at least tens of thousands of citizens wishing to visit him.

And this number was increasing every moment.

“The identity of the Thirteen Peaks Master indeed attracts too much attention.”

Lin Yuan shook his head slightly, setting the visitor filter to Sixth Rank Evolvers, or his own relatives and friends.

Suddenly.

The visitor list cleared out.

“Mom and Dad left me a message.”

Lin Yuan scanned the message list.

The so-called messages were not call requests and wouldn’t disturb Lin Yuan.
